description:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between step number and accuracy. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token prediction)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  A blue solid line with circular markers begins at approximately (0, 0.13) and increases to approximately (60000, 0.43). A turquoise solid line with circular markers begins at approximately (0, 0.13) and increases to approximately (60000, 0.42). A green solid line with circular markers begins at approximately (0, 0.13) and increases to approximately (60000, 0.41).
